title: Worried about how long it will last.
text:
Worried about how long it will last.. This is not very well made but it seems to work okay. I am mainly worried about how long this will last. Two of the blades, are all plastic. The metal blades look like they could fall off very easily after lots of use. I also do not like the fact that this is not dishwasher safe. I do like the way this mandoline stores. All the blades fit into a nice square box which means there will be no looking for pieces to this mandoline in a drawer. The instructions say you just need to rinse with water after each use...but that just doesn't seem sanitary.

If you are looking to give this as a gift...please be aware that the packaging is lacking. It's very cheap looking...like something you could find in the dollar store.

Insert in box (typed exactly as it is written)
IMPORTANT - READ ME
Hi, I'm your new mandoline slicer. Thank you for letting me be a part of your household :)
I can be used for slicing fruits and vegetables thinly and evenly which is great for Gratins or Salads.

I also let you do Julienne cuts which is great for Coleslaw and Stir-fry's.

Before you start cutting ensure that the slicer you have chosen is placed firmly into the small slots on the sides. This is to reduce the risk of the slicer plate slipping while you are slicing.

When working with me without the container start out by having the Mandoline (me) perpendicular (at a right-angle) to you. Do not be tempted to slice with "me" sideways. You'll have the best control over me by pushing the food in a forward motion.

Start out by creating a flat surface (on the piece of fruit or vegetable) for the blade to cut.

For example cut your potato down the middle with a knife to create a flat surface on the inside of the 2 halves.

Safety Comes First

To keep your hands and fingers safe we recommend either using the safety hand guard or a cut resistant glove to prevent you cutting yourselves as the blades are very sharp.

With starchy vegetables is important to lubricate the "runway" as when the starch oozes out of the vegetable it gets very slicky.

Then use consistent even strokes. This makes potato bake a very quick and easy dinner option.

To cut softer vegetables like a tomato apply a zig zag sawing motion gently back and forth. For Julienne vegetables swap inserts. Again start with a flat surface on your vegetable.

To get the most out of the "mincer" grater it is best used for Ginger, essential for any Asian dish and for fresh Ginger Tea.

Also great to zest any critus for dessert cooking.

It's usually a good idea to have a few extra veggies on hand when you're learning to use your mandoline so you can get the hang of the whole process.

And when you're done simply rinse me clean in warm water. I keep very neat and safe, away in my container until next time.

Do not place in boiling water or a dishwasher, the mandoline just needs a rinse off.
